catalogSemantics: Documents, queries, and events describe the complete fictional walkthrough, including future records. Render a checkpoint only from evidence available at its asOfEventId and its explicit availableDocumentIds; future decisions/responses cannot unblock an earlier view. Zero netPayerReceivedPaise means zero matched receipts recorded, not proof that no external payment exists.
